react_native_issues.issue: Recurring console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking; fix by migrating to style.pointerEvents or upgrading react-native-web.

critical_code_review_comments: Main agent context claimed '77/77 pytest' but the actual test count is 76 (verified via pytest run). No test missing/failing — likely a count off-by-one in the handoff note.

compare.tsx reconstructInput() for helicoidal hard-codes inner_radius_mm=150 regardless of what the optimizer used. Consider passing the actual inner used by optimize (currently 150 by default, so this is coincidentally correct, but fragile if inner default changes).

form.tsx buildInput() for helicoidal derives outer_radius_mm = stair_width_mm + stairwell_offset_mm, but reconstructInput() saves outer_radius_mm from the optimizer result. When the saved helico project is reopened, the mapping stairwell_offset_mm/stair_width_mm is derived from outer_radius but the reverse mapping happens via buildInput → risk of round-trip drift. Consider storing helico-specific fields (inner/outer/sweep) in a dedicated form section.
